title: BJP and ABVP march in Giridih over democracy and voter rolls

tea.why: Protesters accused the Congress and opposition parties of misleading people over democracy and electoral roll revisions.
tea.want: Protesters held the march to counter the opposition and support voter list updates.
tea.changed: Nov 3, 2026: Hundreds of BJP members participated in a march in Giridih led by state president Aditya Sahu.

summary: On November 3, 2026, the BJP and its student wing ABVP held separate marches across Jharkhand. In Giridih, hundreds of BJP members and leaders participated in a 'Save Democracy, Remove Anarchy' march. Led by state BJP president Aditya Sahu, along with senior figures such as Babulal Marandi and Ravindra Rai, the procession began at Jhanda Maidan and covered a distance of 300 metres before concluding at Tower Chowk. According to the sources, participants targeted the Congress party and the opposition, alleging that they misled citizens regarding electronic voting machines and voter list revisions. Leaders claimed that the voter roll updates only removed illegal infiltrators rather than eligible voters. No official response or counter-measures from authorities were detailed in the sources.
demands: Support voter list updates and removal of infiltrators
response: No official response reported in the sources.

crowd.text: hundreds of BJP leaders and workers
